description: Search for trucking companies, freight carriers, or motor carriers by company name. Find any carrier's DOT number, MC number, location, fleet size, and operating status. Supports partial name matching. Use this for questions like 'find this trucking company', 'what's the DOT number for Werner?', 'search for freight carriers in Texas', 'look up this logistics company', or any carrier name search. Returns up to 50 matching carriers from the FMCSA national database.
name: fmcsa_carrier_search
